title: Energy Vault -BUSTED!
summary: A Thunderf00t video debunking Energy Vault, a gravity-based energy storage scheme that stacks concrete blocks with cranes. He argues it is impractical and compares it to pseudoscience.
why: Used as a critical reference to argue gravity energy storage is impractical, not as a general recommendation.

quote.text: Several physical and technological factors make Energy Vault completely impractical.
